title: ID0421773-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P0 170001112] Technical Error
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
I'm contacting you because the base station won't reboot. When restarting, the base station remains stuck at 30%. It reboots several times to reach the "initializing runtime" stage. At this point, the base station reboots or displays a black screen. The base station then remains in this state. During my pings with the computer, I can detect router 1 and router 2. I can also connect wired to the interfaces of routers 1 and 2. Can you please schedule an intervention with the necessary equipment as soon as possible? This base station is critical because it is the only one in the station with a chademo connector and a Type 2 connector.
